issues.on_page: Line 18 Local Receipts: Other, TIF FUND column 44,335.95
issues.issue: This is the TIF Fund's only receipt, and it is very likely TIF property tax increment. The printed label is 'Local Receipts: Other', not a tax line, so 'other' follows the tax-split rule (non-tax lines keep their printed meaning). It is a context label and should be settled by the context check. The amount is inside receipts[8] (governmental 'Local Receipts: Other' 75,437.67).
